caption: The drawing depicts three main objects arranged on a beige background. On the left side, there is a carved vertical wooden staff or pole with detailed etchings; at its top is a bird with outstretched wings, likely an eagle, rendered in brown hues. Below the bird, midway down the staff, is the carved figure of a bear climbing upward, also in brown. The lower segment of the staff is decorated with additional patterns and shapes. To the right of the staff, two views of a reddish-brown cylindrical container or vessel are shown, each with a lid featuring animal figures. The lids are circular with a pale rim. On the upper right, the container’s lid supports a recumbent lion, colored in similar brownish-red tones. Below this, a second view of the same container and lid is presented at a different angle, revealing a second animal, a small pale-colored animal, likely a rodent, lying on the lid in front of the lion. In the lower right corner of the page, there is a small, faint sketch of the entire staff and lid assembly. The drawings are shaded and detailed to indicate texture, and the color palette consists mainly of browns, reddish-browns, cream, and pale gray tones.
title: Wood and Stone Carving
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
